core_obligations: An fpqc covering of an affine scheme T admits a refinement by a standard fpqc covering {U_j -> T} with each U_j affine, moreover open affine in one of the T_i: the fpqc definition quantifies over affine opens of T, and T itself is one, so the definition directly yields the finite affine family (proof lines: the definitional extraction).
